errors.text: The proposed LPBF–HIP–aging route does not reconstruct the hydride-containing ink extrusion, hydrogen de-binding, high-vacuum sintering, oxygen-gettering, and water-quenching route.
It treats oxygen and nitrogen primarily as contaminants to suppress, whereas the target relies on controlled oxygen uptake near 1 wt.% for interstitial strengthening.

Coherent B2/L12 precipitation in a nominally Group IV–V BCC alloy is asserted without direct supporting evidence; the cited precipitation study depends on a chemically dissimilar Ni–Fe-containing dual-phase alloy.
The falsification experiment uses mixed elemental powder even though pre-alloyed powder is a central element of the hypothesis, so it cannot cleanly test the proposed intervention.
